en.subtitle: Santorini-inspired architecture by The Haven Bay
en.description: The Hera Resort connects the hills, forest and The Haven Bay in Ghenh Rang, Quy Nhon. Inspired by Santorini, the proposal arranges villas, resort apartments and a marina to follow the terrain and offer views of the sea.

en.subtitle: A retail and office complex
en.description: The Capital One proposal explores a journey through layers of space, from earth and water to the sky and the universe. The design combines retail, offices and landscape, with a glass façade and lighting that emphasise its vertical form.

en.subtitle: Resort spaces and the Onsen experience
en.description: Kawara My An Onsen Resort in Hue brings together accommodation, gardens and mineral bathing in the Japanese tradition. The photographs show bathing areas, guest rooms and landscaped spaces connected to the water.

en.subtitle: An architectural proposal for a hospital
en.description: The Aegis International Hospital proposal arranges tower volumes with green spaces between them. The presentation includes overall perspectives, façade studies and the open spaces between buildings.

en.subtitle: Ryokan architecture and resort landscapes
en.description: The Onsen Wellness Thanh Thuy concept draws inspiration from Kinosaki and traditional Japanese Ryokan architecture. A waterside landscape axis connects resort spaces, pedestrian streets, gardens and Onsen bathing areas, with the aim of creating a wellness village closely connected to nature.

en.subtitle: Onsen architecture and landscape
en.description: The Onsen proposal combines pitched-roof buildings with gardens, water features and bathing pools surrounded by greenery. Corridors and openings direct views from the buildings towards the landscape.

en.subtitle: Homes with open spaces and greenery
en.description: The Nam O Residence proposal in Da Nang takes inspiration from Tsumiki block-building. Its residential volumes integrate greenery to improve ventilation, natural light and connections within the community.
facts: Hoa Hiep Bac, Lien Chieu, Da Nang

en.subtitle: The spirit of Ryokan in contemporary architecture
en.description: The Hakuba Hotel proposal in Nagano interprets the spirit of a traditional Ryokan through contemporary architecture. Pitched roofs, verandas and timber connect the guest experience with Japan's mountain and forest landscapes.

en.subtitle: Hue architecture and a spirit of mindfulness
en.description: The Thien Mu Hotel proposal puts people at its centre, connecting Hue’s architecture with gardens and water. Guided by mindfulness, its open layout aims to offer a peaceful stay that balances tradition with modern comfort.

en.subtitle: An Onsen experience within a green living environment
en.description: The photographs of Onsen at Ecopark Hung Yen show indoor and outdoor bathing spaces, water, natural stone and Japanese-inspired architecture set within the development's green landscape.

en.location: Xuyen Moc, Ba Ria – Vung Tau, Vietnam
en.subtitle: Physical and mental wellbeing beneath the forest canopy
en.description: Binh Minh Physical-Mental Healthcare & Resort is set beneath a forest canopy, next to a coastal area offering a range of tourism services. The project aims to provide an upscale retreat for older guests, combining the natural landscape with facilities that support physical and mental wellbeing. The master plan includes condotels, villas, a healthcare centre, Onsen and mud baths, and a water park.
facts: Xuyen Moc, Ba Ria – Vung Tau, Vietnam
